segments.name: EV charging
segments.description: Provides EV charging services and energy solutions to charging station operators, energy asset owners and EV drivers.
segments.evidence: Accordingly, the Group has identified a single operating and reportable segment in accordance with the requirements of IFRS 8 Operating Segments.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the company for the goods and services it sells in the ordinary course of its activities.
revenueModel.evidence: Revenue is measured at the fair value of the consideration received or receivable for the sales of goods or services in the ordinary course of the Group's activities.

changes.text: In 2025, NaaS shifted away from capital-intensive, low-margin full station operation business.
changes.evidence: In 2025, NaaS kept reinforcing the strategic focus by proactively shifting away from capital-intensive and low-margin full station operation business
